title: Mods: bind Ctrl+X then P to the Control Tower pane when the mod is installed
summary: Installing the Control Tower mod now adds a Ctrl+X then P shortcut to the person's own keybindings file (created if missing, other bindings kept), leaves a chord already in use alone with one warning line, and removing the mod takes the shortcut away; the file is edited with jq, python or PowerShell, whichever exists, and all three agree.
friction: The confirming review (review-192-r2) reported a wall time of about ten hours for 19 tool calls, so the story sat idle overnight; the cause was not found.
lessons_learned: Three file editors (jq, python, PowerShell) for one JSON edit triple the edge cases; the first review found they disagreed on malformed files, so test every editor over one shared list of broken shapes from the start.

deferred.what: The Boundaries list of what orion touches outside a project does not name the person's keybindings file, which mod install and remove now edit, so a later agent reads the boundary as narrower than the code.
deferred.why: CLAUDE.md changes only on the person's word and a person merges it.

deferred.what: The taken-chord check ignores letter case but not alternate spellings such as control+x p, so a binding spelled that way is not seen as taken.
deferred.why: Outside the acceptance criteria; Claude Code's accepted spellings are not documented here.
